summary: Current-run evidence shows extractable product facts and question-form headings on sampled pages, no detected JSON-LD on sampled homepage/product/about pages, valid BlogPosting JSON-LD on sampled article pages, and robots/sitemap signals with limited crawler-rule coverage. AI-engine visibility is unknown.

candidates.title: Product structured data was not detected on sampled homepage and product pages
candidates.area: structured data / entity and product identity
candidates.observation: The current-run structured-data collector reports valid: 0 and invalid: 0 at the homepage and the sampled product pages https://addp.vn/vien-an-duong-addp.html and https://addp.vn/sui-dovital. This is evidence that no JSON-LD was detected by that collector on these page instances; it does not establish the absence of every structured-data format or a sitewide condition. The same run detected valid BlogPosting JSON-LD on sampled article pages, so the result is page-type-specific in this sample.
candidates.suggested_direction: Review public structured data against the stated Organization, Product, and FAQPage requirement for the corresponding page types; validate any proposed markup against visible page facts.
unknowns: Other structured-data syntaxes may exist outside the JSON-LD collector result.
Coverage is limited to sampled URLs; other homepage/product templates may differ.
No conclusion about AI-engine citation or visibility follows from this result.

rubric.detail: Zero valid and zero invalid JSON-LD records in the collector output for these sampled pages. Checklist reference REQ-010-01.
The evidence artifacts contain valid BlogPosting entities with headline, author, publisher, and publication/modification dates.

candidates.title: Product page provides question-led, extractable information but no dedicated FAQ heading is evidenced
candidates.observation: The extracted heading list includes direct questions about product effect, eligible users, and use instructions; extracted page text contains short answers, product ingredients, dosage instructions, and a warning that the supplement is not a medicine and does not replace treatment. The heading list has no FAQ/Hỏi đáp heading, and the evidence reviewed does not establish the specific FAQ block and 40–60-word direct-answer format described by REQ-007-05. The evidence supports a page-level opportunity, not a claim that FAQ content is absent everywhere.
candidates.suggested_direction: Retain the clear question-led sections and assess adding a clearly labeled FAQ with concise, directly responsive answers, grounded in approved product information and medical review where needed.
unknowns: A full editorial assessment of all body content, answer lengths, references, and medical accuracy is outside this evidence-based finding.
No assessment of the other product detail pages' FAQ usefulness is implied.

rubric.detail: Question-form H2s and short answer text are present in the captured extraction.
No dedicated FAQ heading is present in the extracted heading list; complete component and word-count coverage was not established.

candidates.title: robots.txt is reachable, but AI crawler directives are not explicit in the captured rules
candidates.observation: The robots.txt endpoint returned HTTP 200. Its captured content contains a general User-agent: * section and multiple Disallow rules, but no explicit named rules for ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, or Google-Extended. The captured document alone does not establish how each crawler interprets the wildcard rules or whether other access controls apply.
candidates.suggested_direction: Review intended access policy for each named crawler against the complete robots directives and verify public endpoint behavior for the relevant paths.
unknowns: Crawler behavior and actual crawling are not evidenced.
No inference about AI-engine visibility or recommendation is supported.
Robots directives do not prove access through or restriction by other mechanisms.

rubric.detail: Endpoint content was collected; the captured directives do not explicitly name the three crawlers listed in REQ-011-01.
No direct evidence of AI-engine visibility, citation, or recommendation was collected.

candidates.title: The sitemap URLs declared or probed in this run returned 404
candidates.observation: The collected robots.txt names https://addp.vn/pub/sitemap.xml, and the run recorded HTTP 404 responses for that URL and https://addp.vn/sitemap.xml. These endpoint responses make the referenced sitemap unavailable at collection time; the audit did not establish whether another sitemap endpoint exists or whether the site's pages are otherwise discoverable.
candidates.suggested_direction: Check the configured sitemap location and publish a reachable sitemap there if that declaration is intended to be authoritative.
unknowns: No claim is made that no other sitemap exists.

rubric.detail: Both endpoints returned 404 in the current run.

keep_protect.observation: The sampled Viên An Đường page organizes information under direct question headings and includes short answers, ingredients/use details, and a plain-language supplement disclaimer.
The sampled diabetes articles expose valid BlogPosting JSON-LD with article headline, author, dates, and ADDP publisher identity.

rubric.detail: Homepage title identifies ADDP as Công ty Trách nhiệm Hữu hạn Dược phẩm ADDP; article JSON-LD publisher is Công ty TNHH Dược phẩm ADDP.
Question headings and concise answers appear in the extraction.

rubric.item: FAQ usefulness and FAQ structured data
rubric.detail: A useful dedicated FAQ block is not established by captured headings; no JSON-LD was detected on sampled product/homepage pages.
The captured heading hierarchies include question-form headings on Viên An Đường and descriptive section headings on the Dovital landing page.

rubric.item: Definitions, comparisons, explanations, sourceability, research support, and citation-ready passages
rubric.detail: The run captures selected headings and metadata but does not provide a complete expert assessment of source quality, supporting references, fact consistency, or citation suitability.
Article JSON-LD supplies a named author field, ADDP publisher, and publication/modification dates; author name is rendered as admin admin in the sampled markup.
No exhaustive cross-page fact comparison or independent validation was performed.
robots.txt was reachable (200); both collected sitemap URLs returned 404. Named crawler behavior is not established.
No JSON-LD detected on sampled homepage/product pages; valid BlogPosting JSON-LD detected on sampled article pages.
No direct evidence in current-run artifacts; no visibility score or citation behavior inferred.

coverage_and_limits.scope_note: Current-run public/external artifacts only. Findings are limited to named page instances unless a reviewer-provided pattern_key supports a pattern; no pattern_key was provided or used.
explicit_unknowns: Private crawler treatment and actual crawl outcomes
Sitewide generalization beyond collected page instances
Independent medical truth or credential validation
